conf.description: ServiceNow change request (change_request), JSON file via System Export Sets: JSON extract + ECS/custom field mapping, direct route.

conf.comment: ServiceNow change request (change_request) via System Export Sets JSON file. Direct route. state is an integer choice-list code; its instance-specific sys_choice label lookup is NOT implemented (no lookup table is available in this work order, see README gap) - the raw code is passed through to servicenow.change.state. type/approval are JSON-export display values (labels) per ServiceNow's default reference/choice rendering and are passed through as-is. work_start/work_end have no fallback to a planned window because no planned-window vendor field name is given in this work order (see README gap).

functions.description: Cribl File Source reads the exported JSON array; extract fields from _raw

map the correlation columns to servicenow.change.*, put the display-name assigned_to on user.name (full name, not login - see README gap for user.id), derive event.outcome from close_code while retaining the raw value, set _time from the sys_updated_on watermark, tag event.dataset
Re-nest flat dotted keys (data-maps canonical step)
